movieNoteTex: The $31\times31$-generator vortex computation of Figure~\ref{fig:lloyd-summary}, from $t=0$ to $t=1$, computed with the method of \cite{despres2024,desprem} on an initially Cartesian mesh. For display, particle positions are interpolated between the accepted time steps and the tessellation is rebuilt for every frame; the first and last frames are the recorded states.
